note: Mixed. ORIGINAL (client files: UIResource/UIImage_hd butler_event_name_bN, butler_event_profile_bN and butler_event_text_bN .png; string table 9854-9867): the seven names; each butler's blood type, birthday, keywords and quote (profile, record only: no verified protocol field); the ability names Fishing, collecting Drops and mining; the portrait (art, served unchanged); the skin picture (skin_image: the server's skin and main pictures as the robo iOS device cached them, cache/butler/butler_skin_master/ and butler_main/, 2026-11-16; matched to each butler by eye: skin_image (butler_skin_master, Ophelia, Ian and Merry) is sent as skinImgUrl and in Skin Select instead of the event portrait; reward_image (butler_main, Kai, Celina, Elena and Michel) is sent as the gather reward's butlerRewardImg, the field the client shows it in, butler-robo-spec); the outfit item ids that match a true item (catalog items with art, matched by eye; see each butler's note); gender (read from the portrait, [I]). CHERRY-PICKED LOOK-ALIKES (field lookalikes, always a subset of outfit): Cherry-picked look-alike: an original catalog item chosen by Cherry because the true item is not in any archive; user decision 2026-10-29. Each one is an original item of the same slot that looks closest to the true item, which is not used; the faces (EY, EB, MO, NO) and the animal ears have no true match in any archive. CHERRY-MADE: the ids (1900000004-1900000010 in the Cherry block; 1900000001-1900000003 were Cherry's Hazel, Wren and Oswin, retired and never reused), the skin codes and skin ids (one default skin per butler: its outfit), skin_color (an original skin-palette index of the client, g_akHBC 0 to 16, chosen by Cherry from the portraits: 1 is the untinted base that matches the pale portraits; 0 is a tan tint and is wrong for the six human butlers; Merry is ANIMAL: the client ignores skin_color for animals (she keeps 0); her body colour comes from her FA outfit item instead; the palette decode is in the butler audit notes, skin-palette.md), the ability-to-gather-kind mapping (Fishing = fish, collecting Drops = essence (the Korean card says essence absorption), mining = ore), free_days, hire (the one 30-day period at 30 earned Cash), and gathering gems, gems_cap, gathers_per_day and duration_minutes (60 minutes from a gathering's start to its collect: Cherry-made, the client shows no duration of its own). Hire prices are in earned Cash (cash). The client's contract picker offers only 30-day periods (CButtonHandler 0x22cfb84), so hire lists the one 30-day period. The free first hire (free_days) is a separate path. SKINS (2026-11-16): each butler's skins list starts with its default skin, which keeps the code, outfit, skin_color, lookalikes and picture this file had before the list existed; the default's id is the butler's number. A further skin (Merry only so far) is Cherry-made in name, price and id (its butler's sub-block of the Cherry skin block 1900001000-1900100999: 1900001000 + 100 x (butler id - 1900000000) + k); its picture is an original skin picture of the robo iOS cache. VOICES (2026-11-16): an optional voice pack per butler (Merry only): the audio is original; the Voice Book labels and the empty texts are Cherry-made. MEMORIES (2026-11-16): Merry's two memories (her note); the memory pictures are ORIGINAL robo iOS cache files in cache/butler/butler_memory_master/, the memory ids, titles, scene lines and the top message are Cherry-made. CHAT (2026-11-17): chat_greeting, the Chat popup's first line for every butler, and talk_line, the Talk popup's line ("I'm bored! Play with me!"; Cherry keeps no intimacy, so the heart gauge stays 0 of 100), are CHERRY-MADE. The Chat's button labels are in code (internal/lpn/garden_butler.go, not in this file): "I'm bored! Play with me!", "Take me to the butler list!" and "Make me a special order!" are the client's strings (butler-robo-spec 10.3); "Currently collecting." and "Collecting complete!" are client strings for the gathering states (their button is not device-checked); "Please gather!" and "Memories" are CHERRY-MADE. SPECIAL ORDERS (2026-11-17): the whole special_order object is CHERRY-MADE (the client has no table of materials, rewards or prices, butler-robo-spec 11.9): the material list (its item ids are the gathering drops of data/gathering.json, original ids, their names are Cherry's), the star grade of each material, which is Cherry's INFERENCE from the item id (the second digit: 11xxxx, 21xxxx and 31xxxx are grade 1; 12xxxx, 22xxxx and 32xxxx grade 2; 13xxxx, 23xxxx and 33xxxx grade 3; the client shows no grade table), the material count, the reward (type 106 Gems or 105 Cash, and its amount), the daily limit per_day and the reward popup's line thanks. The wire carries grade minus 1 (requireItemGrade is 0-based, shown as G+1 stars).

MEMORIES (2026-11-16): two memories, ids 1 and 2; the ids, titles, scene lines (no voice) and the memory_message are CHERRY-MADE. Memory 1 is the bedroom: its scene picture is ORIGINAL Merry_1630072965.png (640 x 1500), its list picture and thumbnail ORIGINAL Merry_Thumbnail_1630072965.png (608 x 430); the copies Merry_1630074702.png and the Merry_Thumbnail files at 1630074702, 1631583636 and 1633414639 are byte-identical to these. Memory 2 is the rose greenhouse: its list picture is ORIGINAL admin_img_list_thum_1630075205.png (608 x 430; the copies at 1630075756 and 1631583536 are identical), its scene picture is ORIGINAL butler_memory_make_bg_1630075205.png, a full-bleed 640 x 1500 greenhouse picture (INFERRED from size and layout: no protocol field or pseudocode names the scene picture by file), and its thumbnail is the list picture.
